description: This file defines API endpoints related to food delivery operations in a FastAPI application. It includes functions for assigning orders to couriers, accepting assignments, marking pickup and delivery, along with various helper functions for authorization, data retrieval, and state validation.

methods.name: bool _is_admin(user: User)
methods.description: Checks if the user has administrator privileges.

methods.name: Order _get_order_or_404(session: AsyncSession, order_id: UUID)
methods.description: Fetches an Order by ID, raises 404 if not found.

methods.name: DeliveryAssignment _get_assignment(session: AsyncSession, order_id: UUID)
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a DeliveryAssignment for an order.

methods.name: None _assert_restaurant_manage_access(session: AsyncSession, restaurant_id: UUID, user: User)
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to manage the restaurant's delivery.

methods.name: OrderOut _order_to_out(order: Order)
methods.description: Converts an Order object into an OrderOut schema for API responses.

methods.name: None _assert_role(user: User, role: UserRole)
methods.description: Ensures a user has a specific role.

methods.name: None _assert_status(order: Order, expected: OrderStatus)
methods.description: Checks if an Order is in the expected status.

methods.name: None _assert_delivery_user_assigned(assignment: DeliveryAssignment, courier_user: User)
methods.description: Verifies if the current user is the assigned delivery person.

methods.name: DeliveryAssignmentOut assign_order_to_courier( order_id: UUID, payload: AssignCourierRequest, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )

OrderOut courier_mark_delivered( order_id: UUID, _: CourierActionRequest, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
OrderOut courier_mark_picked_up( order_id: UUID, _: CourierActionRequest, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
